answer: Opal Vouching Quorums: each new identity must anchor itself by posting a 200-opal bond and collecting attestations from 3 established peers, but each voucher can only forge 2 attestations per epoch. Creating N fakes requires 1.5N vouchers, so total cost scales quadratically as voucher supply tightens, and bonds are slashed if 2 peers revoke their attestation within 3 epochs.
